rca_of_issue: Previous blocked splash evidence was a tooling deadlock: Playwright screenshot waited on fonts while tests intentionally held font requests. Using Chromium CDP Page.captureScreenshot captured held-font splash state successfully, then releasing real font requests allowed normal startup completion without mocks or production delays.
